summary: Executed both backend and frontend testing for shared-v1-2026-09-11. Backend: added isolated synthetic-db pytest suite under /app/backend/tests/shared with shared.core.db and server.db patched to test DB; SMS dispatcher intercepted in tests only; 17/17 tests passed (iter11_results.xml). Verified OTP challenge behavior (no fixed OTP, cooldown, expiry, single-use), enrollment grants, refresh rotation/reuse revocation, last-admin guard, same-subject service exchange, phone-change conflict no partial update, requests pagination with >200 records and race claim behavior, IST metrics endpoints, rates/slab role scopes, media validation, sample PDF exact-code parsing and pixel-compare crop fidelity, and dry-run identity reconciliation contract. Frontend (mobile 390x844 at https://app-first-signin.preview.emergentagent.com): login rendering validated, registration-required state validated, no demo-credential hint text observed, unauth route guards validated for staff-requests/customer-directory/staff-rates/pdf-import, verify-otp rendering validated. Authenticated role-workspace flows could not be executed in public environment due no approved non-production credentials and requirement to avoid genuine DB mutation.
